Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with C.T. Case No. 33 of 2022(POCSO), arising out of Kesinga P.S. Case No. 136 of 2022 pending before the Court of the learned Adhoc Addl. Sessions Judge(Fast Track Special Court), Kalahandi, Bhawanipatna, for alleged commission of offences under Sections 354-A/354-B/376- AB/341/323/376(2) of IPC and Sec. 6 and 12 of POCSO Act.
3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Adhoc Addl. Dist & Sessions Judge(Fast Track Special Court), Kalahandi, Bhawanipatna, by order dated 20.12.2022 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. By order dated 14.11.2022 in BLAPL No. 9381 of 2022, this Court rejected the bail application of the Petitioner, taking note of the fact that victim is aged about 10 years and her 164 statement and liberty is granted to the Petitioner to renew his prayer after examination of the victim and also to concluded the trial within a period of four months from the date of receipt/ production of the copy of this order.
7. Even before expiry of the period, as stipulated by the order referred herein above, assailing the order dated 20.12.2022 passed by the learned Additional District and Sessions Judge, Kalahandi,
